scripts.typecheck: cargo check --workspace --all-targets && tsc --noEmit -p types/tsconfig.json && bun run --filter '*' typecheck
scripts.lint: bun run lint:conflicts && bun run lint:atomic && bun run lint:testids && bun run lint:boundaries && bun run lint:rust && bun run lint:lua && bun run lint:stylua && bun run codegen:check && bun run --filter '*' lint
scripts.format: bun run --filter '*' format && cargo fmt --all && bun scripts/stylua.ts format
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && bun run lint:deps && cargo deny check
scripts.test: cargo nextest run --workspace && bun test types scripts && bun run --filter '*' test
